id: title:Twixes:archive signal report when its pr closes unmerged

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies the webhook's signal-report lifecycle, distinguishing merged vs. unmerged PR outcomes.
review.reason: The change updates the webhook's signal-report handling to support both RESOLVED and SUPPRESSED states, not just RESOLVED, and updates documentation and tests accordingly. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The connection to PostHog is established through the provided observations, but the actual implementation and relevant checks are not visible in the supplied hunk descriptions. The tier is assigned based on the described behavior, not the complete implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. No score assigned as requested.

observations.behavior: Docstring and test assertion updated to reflect new behavior: webhook now archives reports when PR closes unmerged.
observations.code_quote: """Webhook resolves a SignalReport when its PR merges, and archives it when the PR closes unmerged."""
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the webhook's signal-report lifecycle, distinguishing merged vs. unmerged PR outcomes.

observations.behavior: Test expectation updated: closed-unmerged PR now results in SUPPRESSED status instead of READY.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the expected status of signal reports when a PR closes without merging, indicating reports are archived rather than kept ready.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct call to _resolve_signal_reports_for_task with _transition_signal_reports_for_task, passing explicit status and event log.
